texts: On day 155 of Year 1, six sky-cats were visible on the cliff-spires in the morning.
Tessa Brae collected about twenty feathers per morning in that week.
Tessa Brae reported to the Council that the sky-cats had begun to return.
Bevin Coombe asked the Council to consider Halden for a permanent station.
Halden had tended the Stilllight Lantern well since the wraith.
The Council approved an apprenticeship-completion track for Halden.

q1_issues.issue: Cardinality's count slot is specified as a native integer, but the parse puts a ParticleFromNormal distribution in it for "about twenty".
The frame adverbial "in that week" is dropped entirely, so the collecting habit is asserted without its stated temporal restriction.

The distributed flat half of the past-tense copular "were visible" concludes a bare (Member $x visible) with no Past wrapper, although the surface tense is required to wrap every categorical atom the clause yields.
(Start sk_tend_1 sk_wraith_1) fills the interval Start slot with an entity witness typed (Member sk_wraith_1 wraith) rather than a time term or a reified eventuality.
"about twenty feathers per morning" is encoded as one shared ~20-feather group under a recurring event, so the per-morning count reads as the same twenty feathers every morning.

q2_gaps: approximated cardinal count ("about twenty N") — Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague quantities, and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure/clock slots
a count distributed per occasion under a habitual/frequency reading ("twenty feathers per morning") — no way to scope the count inside each recurrence
anaphoric week-level temporal frame ("in that week") — there is no Week term, and term propagation has no week-level term in the antecedent to copy
interval "since <entity NP>" where the anchor is an elliptical/metonymic event ("since the wraith") — Start's argument is defined as a time term and the event-noun anchor rule needs an eventuality
ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 155 of Year 1") — (Day n) is defined as the day slot of a calendar date, so (Day 155) overloads it

an indefinite introduced inside a top-level-reified control complement ("consider Halden for a permanent station") is asserted to exist at top level; only seals have a non-committal carrier for such a witness
review.notes: The harder constructions are handled well: the control complement of "asked ... to consider" is reified at top level with the object controller copied in, and the sealed report complement keeps its past perfect inside the seal with no cross-seal Before and carries the plural distribution rule as a sealed conjunct.

issues.reason: Cardinality's count slot is specified as "a native integer" and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family magnitude slots (Measures & units; the approximate clock-time value slot), so a distribution term there is ill-typed and would break the hard-integer Compute test the counting-question rule prescribes.

Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction, and here the omission genuinely widens the claim: (Every sk_collect_1 1 day) with no window asserts a standing daily habit the text confines to that one week, while term propagation licensed carrying at least the antecedent's (Time sk_collect_1 (Year 1)).

Status predicates: "the surface tense decides, mechanically ... it wraps every categorical atom the clause yields", so the distributed flat half of "were visible" must conclude (Past (Member $x visible)); the bare conclusion asserts present visibility of each sky-cat, which the sentence does not state.

Start/End take a time term (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour, or a day-part constant), but sk_wraith_1 is an entity witness explicitly typed (Member sk_wraith_1 wraith), so a "when did the tending start?" query binds a creature in a time slot.

One event witness with one ~20-member feather group under (Every sk_collect_1 1 day) says the very same twenty feathers were collected every morning — false of "about twenty feathers per morning", and the count is equally wrong read as the week's aggregate.

gaps_confirmed: approximated cardinal count ("about twenty N") — Cardinality demands a native integer, CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague quantities, and ParticleFromNormal is confined to Measure-family slots
a count scoped per occasion under a habitual/frequency reading ("twenty feathers per morning") — no way to put the count inside each recurrence
anaphoric week-level temporal frame ("in that week") — the term inventory has no Week, so term propagation has nothing at that level to copy
interval "since <entity NP>" with an elliptical/metonymic event anchor ("since the wraith") — Start takes a time term and Before takes an eventuality, and the NP supplies neither
ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 155 of Year 1") — (Day n) is the day-of-month slot, so (Day 155) overloads it

an indefinite introduced inside a top-level-reified control complement ("consider Halden for a permanent station") gets a top-level witness asserting a station that does not yet exist; only a seal has a non-committal carrier for it
new_gaps: a habitual/frequency claim confined to a stated past window ("collected ... per morning in that week") — Every/TimesPer carry no interval slot, WithinLast is now-anchored and backward-only, and the frequency section's unmarked-habitual form asserts a standing disposition rather than a one-week one

a rate whose counted noun is a participant rather than an occurrence ("twenty feathers per morning") — TimesPer counts event occurrences only, and the Measure rate-unit route (feather_per_morning) has no stated dimension, forcing the reserved `unspecified` scale
adjudication.defect_summary: The approximate count has no licensed integer form, so the compliant parse keeps the feather group, omits the Cardinality atom, and files the gap. The "in that week" frame should at minimum carry the propagated (Time sk_collect_1 (Year 1)), with the week-level residue filed as a gap, rather than leaving the daily habit unrestricted. The distribution rule's conclusion should be (Implication (PartOf $x sk_sky_cats_1) (Past (Member $x visible))). "Since the wraith" has no licensed carrier at all — Start wants a time term, Before wants an eventuality, and sk_wraith_1 is an entity — so the phrase should be left unencoded and filed as a gap. The per-morning count likewise has no per-occasion scope, so it must be dropped rather than ridden on one shared group shared across every recurrence.
adjudication.notes: The control complement of "asked ... to consider" (top-level, tenseless, object controller copied in) and the sealed report complement (past perfect kept inside the seal, plural distribution rule as a sealed conjunct) are both handled as the instruction set prescribes. Three of the five confirmed defects are the same underlying shortfall — a count and a window that the frequency machinery cannot scope — so a single sentence drives most of this record's loss.
